neighbours.label: the verb 'get' in its acquire/become senses (gets most of, get used to, got his stitches out)
fire: Every winter the north of the country gets most of the snow.
Owls are curious and quickly get used to their keepers.
My son finally got his braces off at the dentist today.
Commuters are getting more annoyed with the late trains.
In this town, the mayor always gets the final word.
The puppy gets excited whenever the doorbell rings.
We hope to get tickets before the show sells out.
Prices got higher every month last year.
quiet: Every winter the north of the country receives most of the snow.
Owls are curious and quickly grow used to their keepers.
My son finally had his braces removed at the dentist today.
Commuters are becoming more annoyed with the late trains.
In this town, the mayor always has the final word.
The puppy becomes excited whenever the doorbell rings.
We hope to buy tickets before the show sells out.
Prices rose higher every month last year.

notes: Card flags dense (10% of tokens >0.1 max) with a gate-closed echo regime; 'get' forms are 30 of the top 32 peaks. The - pole is 'I get it' (= understand).
